# An outlet that keeps search, previews and its API from every crawler, and shuts out two named bots
Sitemap: https://outlet.test/sitemap.xml

User-agent: *
Disallow: /search/
Allow: /search/$
Disallow: /preview/*
Disallow: /api
Disallow: /*.json$
Disallow: /*?share=
Disallow: /*&share=
Disallow: /news/live/
Allow: /news/live/summary
Disallow:

User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
